title: London Underground 1996 Stock Refurbished
description: This project is a reskin of a 1996 stock.
body: The 1996 Stock (1996TS) is a fleet of electric multiple-unit trains that operates exclusively on the London Underground's Jubilee Line. Originally introduced to service in 1997, the 1996TS underwent a major mid-life refurbishment between 2017 and 2019.
